market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Oil-driven inflation pressure and VIX complacency create asymmetric downside risk. Apple/Google events provide near-term catalysts but high expectations limit upside. EM strength and Polish inflows offer relative value. Expect choppy, range-bound US equities with sector rotation toward energy and defensives. Japan yield surge is the key wildcard—any JGB acceleration could trigger global risk-off.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. AI capex cycle (Nvidia, Google, Micron) supports tech leadership but Taiwan supply risk and custom silicon competition add volatility. Consumer contraction favors staples and value. EM capital formation (India, Poland) offers 12-month upside. Housing affordability crisis and rate stickiness cap broad market gains. Ultra-rich cash rotation may signal 6-9 month top in risk assets.
